newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Blue Star ups McCollam stake to 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Blue Star ups McCollam stake to 20 pct.

text.p: Blue Star Office Technology, part of the U.S Office Products Co vehicle bidding for New Zealand's McCollam Printers Ltd, has increased its voting stake to 20.11 percent from 17.54 percent, the firms said in a stock exchange statement released on Tuesday.

Blue Star launched a takeover bid for McCollam on May 16, saying it would pay NZ$2.75 per share to shareholders other than controlling family interests with whom it intended to strike a separate deal.
Meanwhile it has also bought shares through the market.
Independent directors at the weekend recommended that shareholders accept the offer following conclusion of an outside report and valuation commissioned from Merrill Lynch.
The offer document is expected to go to holders later this week.
